markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set, 0% invasive risk, full model agreement, and tier-4 routine priority [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Top probabilities | Normal 100%, Benign 0%, InSitu 0%, Invasive 0% | Near-certain Normal; 5% test ECE |
| Conformal set | Normal (10% alpha, 90% test coverage) | Single class at 90% guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 68th OOD percentile, 12/12 regions [F6] | Typical input; all regions kept |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | True (same top class) | Independent foundation models agree |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal (90–92% similarity) [F5] | All nearest reference cases match |

## Tissue evidence
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 4, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (1.34, contribution -0.59) opposes invasion [F2] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 3, 5, 6) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical text score (1.42, contribution -0.55) opposes invasion [F3] · Weak
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 6) · context · Above-typical score (0.99); AI spot check 8/20 [F4] · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Low score (-0.53, contribution +0.37); spot check 12/20 · Weak
- **Dead cell fraction** (regions 3, 9, 10) · context · 8% (97th percentile, 9 cells); wrong validation direction [F7] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful in validation (removing top-3 risk regions drops invasive score by 0.0114 vs random, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven classifier faithfulness (deletion CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); minimal weight on unreliable `mitoses` (0/20), `necrosis` (3/20), `normal_lobules` (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Focal in situ disease mimics contrast case `BACH_0117` (InSitu, 86% similarity), differing in `duct_confined` and `tubules` (`caption_consistent=false`).
- Focal atypia is missed across unsampled regions (`insufficient_tumor_nuclei` flag; 12 neoplastic-labeled nuclei in region 3).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 8, 9**: Check stroma and nuclei where `pleomorphism` (0.67), `invasion` (0.54), and tile risk (0.003) peak.
2. **Regions 3, 5, 6**: Confirm benign tubules and inspect the 12 neoplastic-labeled nuclei in region 3.
3. **Regions 4, 10, 11**: Verify benign stroma/fat, exclude ductal atypia in 11, and check 6 dead cells in 10.
